verdict.rationale: Marqeta supports virtual card issuance, merchant-restriction authorization controls, and velocity/spending caps that together enable single-merchant, amount-limited cards, but there is no explicit single-use/one-transaction-then-auto-decline card feature documented. missing for 10: explicit single-use/one-time-use card mechanism, exact-amount-per-transaction enforcement, and evidence/independent confirmation of a leaked-card-becomes-worthless-after-use guarantee.
